title: 函数图象问题
summary: 求直线与坐标轴围成面积及正值范围
scene_svg:
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="inkGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fdfbf7"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fee2e2"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="axisGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#44403c"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f2937"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
  </filter>
  <filter id="glowRed" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#8a1c1c" flood-opacity="0.45"/>
  </filter>
  <marker id="arrowInk" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="5" orient="auto">
    <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 Z" fill="#1f2937"/>
  </marker>
</defs>
<style>
  .ink{stroke:#1f2937;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .mid{stroke:#44403c;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .light{stroke:#78716c;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .txt{fill:#1f2937;font-size:22px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
  .small{fill:#44403c;font-size:18px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
  .tiny{fill:#78716c;font-size:16px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
  .red{fill:#8a1c1c;stroke:#8a1c1c}
  .dashed-line{stroke:#78716c;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-dasharray:8 7;fill:none}
  .transition-all{transition:all .8s ease-in-out}
  @keyframes floatUpDown{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0px)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
  @keyframes pulseInk{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.06)}}
  @keyframes dashFlow{0%{stroke-dashoffset:0}100%{stroke-dashoffset:-30}}
  @keyframes glowBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.55}}
  .floaty{animation:floatUpDown 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
  .pulse{animation:pulseInk 2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
  .flow{animation:dashFlow 2.2s linear infinite}
  .blink{animation:glowBlink 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
</style>
<g>
  <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="70" y="70" width="660" height="460" rx="22" fill="#fdfbf7" opacity="0.9"/>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
    <line x1="140" y1="460" x2="670" y2="460" stroke="url(#axisGrad)" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrowInk)"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="510" x2="220" y2="100" stroke="url(#axisGrad)" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrowInk)"/>
    <text x="682" y="468" class="txt">x</text>
    <text x="210" y="92" class="txt">y</text>
    <text x="198" y="483" class="small">O</text>

    <g class="light" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.45">
      <line x1="300" y1="120" x2="300" y2="460"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="120" x2="380" y2="460"/>
      <line x1="460" y1="120" x2="460" y2="460"/>
      <line x1="540" y1="120" x2="540" y2="460"/>
      <line x1="620" y1="120" x2="620" y2="460"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="380" x2="670" y2="380"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="300" x2="670" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="220" x2="670" y2="220"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="140" x2="670" y2="140"/>
    </g>

    <text x="292" y="486" class="tiny">1</text>
    <text x="372" y="486" class="tiny">2</text>
    <text x="452" y="486" class="tiny">3</text>
    <text x="532" y="486" class="tiny">4</text>
    <text x="612" y="486" class="tiny">5</text>
    <text x="192" y="386" class="tiny">2</text>
    <text x="192" y="306" class="tiny">4</text>
    <text x="192" y="226" class="tiny">6</text>
    <text x="192" y="146" class="tiny">8</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <path d="M220 140 L540 460" class="ink" stroke-width="5" filter="url(#glowRed)"/>
    <text x="470" y="230" class="txt red floaty">y = −2x + 8</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 2" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <circle cx="220" cy="140" r="7" fill="#8a1c1c" class="pulse"/>
    <rect x="238" y="118" width="146" height="38" rx="12" fill="url(#inkGrad)" stroke="#8a1c1c"/>
    <text x="250" y="143" class="small">x = 0 时，y = 8</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <circle cx="540" cy="460" r="7" fill="#8a1c1c" class="pulse"/>
    <rect x="556" y="432" width="148" height="38" rx="12" fill="url(#inkGrad)" stroke="#8a1c1c"/>
    <text x="568" y="456" class="small">y = 0 时，x = 4</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 4" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
    <polygon points="220,460 220,140 540,460" fill="#fee2e2" opacity="0.8" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="332" y="355" class="txt red blink">△面积</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
    <line x1="220" y1="140" x2="220" y2="460" class="dashed-line flow"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="460" x2="540" y2="460" class="dashed-line flow"/>
    <rect x="258" y="474" width="92" height="32" rx="10" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#78716c"/>
    <text x="278" y="495" class="small">底 = 4</text>
    <rect x="88" y="278" width="92" height="32" rx="10" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#78716c"/>
    <text x="107" y="299" class="small">高 = 8</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 6" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-3" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <rect x="510" y="118" width="176" height="72" rx="16" fill="url(#inkGrad)" stroke="#8a1c1c" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="526" y="148" class="small">面积 = 4 × 8 ÷ 2</text>
    <text x="552" y="176" class="txt red pulse">= 16</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 7" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
    <rect x="88" y="110" width="122" height="42" rx="14" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#44403c"/>
    <text x="102" y="137" class="small">再看 y > 0</text>
    <line x1="380" y1="460" x2="380" y2="220" class="dashed-line flow"/>
    <circle cx="380" cy="300" r="8" fill="#8a1c1c"/>
    <rect x="398" y="282" width="138" height="38" rx="12" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#8a1c1c"/>
    <text x="412" y="307" class="small">线在 x 轴上方</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 8" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <path d="M220 140 L540 460" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.18" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M220 140 L540 460" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="460" x2="540" y2="460" class="dashed-line"/>
    <text x="286" y="430" class="txt red">对应 0 < x < 4</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 9" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100">
    <rect x="480" y="350" width="200" height="90" rx="18" fill="url(#inkGrad)" stroke="#8a1c1c" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="500" y="382" class="small">两个结论</text>
    <text x="500" y="410" class="small">三角形面积 = 16</text>
    <text x="500" y="438" class="small">x 的范围：0 < x < 4</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 10" x-transition:enter="transition-all duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-2" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <rect x="86" y="500" width="620" height="30" rx="14" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#78716c"/>
    <circle :cx="sceneStep >= 10 ? 380 : 220" cy="515" r="10" fill="#8a1c1c" class="pulse transition-all"/>
    <text x="110" y="520" class="tiny">检验：x = 2 时，y = 4 > 0；x = 5 时，y = −2 < 0，所以范围判断正确。</text>
  </g>
</g>
